manifest.name: dsh-google-chrome-use
manifest.description: Let DeepSeek Harness use Google Chrome on macOS and Windows: a dedicated profile that stays logged in, or the Chrome you already use. Powered by Chrome DevTools MCP.

scripts.check: pnpm run test && pnpm run smoke && pnpm pack --pack-destination .artifacts

manifest.author: BaronCyrus

bundle.text:
# Register the chrome_use tool. The browser tools stay out of the model's tool
# list until a task calls it, so sessions that never open a browser pay nothing.
- insert:
    - id: chrome-use
      name: 'dsh-google-chrome-use'

readme.section: Chrome Use：给 DeepSeek Harness 一个真实的 Chrome
readme.text:
[English](README.en.md)

让 DSH 的模型使用你电脑上的 Google Chrome：打开网页、读内容、点击、填表、选下拉、上传文件、处理弹窗、截图。支持 macOS 和 Windows。Windows 目前只跑过 CI 上的自动化测试，还没有在实机的桌面版上试过，遇到问题欢迎反馈。

底层是 Chrome 官方的 [chrome-devtools-mcp](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp)。这个插件负责把它接进 DSH：按需加载、连接哪个 Chrome、不同系统上的路径、隐私默认值和按网站询问。

| | 独立 Chrome（默认） | 我的 Chrome |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 是什么 | 单独的 Chrome 配置，在这里登录过的账号下次还在 | 你正在用的那个 Chrome，带着全部登录状态和标签页 |
| 适合 | 查资料、测网页、只交给模型特定账号 | 需要用你已登录的账号时 |
| 准备工作 | 不用准备 | Chrome 144 或更新版本，勾选一次，macOS 还要开一次文件夹权限，连接时点允许 |

需要哪种直接说就行，模型会自己选：

```text
用 Chrome 打开 example.com，告诉我页面标题
用我自己的 Chrome 看看 GitHub 上有没有新通知
```

不需要 Chrome 扩展，也不用安装别的东西。

先准备好 [Google Chrome](https://www.google.com/chrome/) 和 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版（0.2.1 及以上的 0.2.x 版本）。

1. 打开桌面应用的**插件**页，点击**添加插件**，在**包名或地址**中填入：

```text
   dsh-google-chrome-use@0.2.1
   ```

安装源选择**官方源**，点击**安装**。新版本刚发布的 24 小时内，DSH 的 pnpm 会因为发布冷却期暂缓安装，所以请带上版本号。

2. **完全退出并重新打开** DSH 桌面应用。只刷新页面不会加载 Host 端的新插件。

3. 在对话里说「用 Chrome 打开 example.com，告诉我页面标题」试试。

<details>
<summary>命令行和自建 profile</summary>

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-google-chrome-use@0.2.1
```

不要对 `desktop` profile 使用这条命令，桌面版请走插件页。DSH 0.1.5 的 headless 模式没有附件存储，模型收不到截图，其他功能正常。

</details>

第一次让模型用你的 Chrome 时，按它的提示做这几步：

1. **只有 macOS 需要：** 到「系统设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 文件与文件夹」，在 DeepSeek Harness 下面打开 Google Chrome（用命令行版时是你的终端程序）。不开的话插件读不到 Chrome 的文件夹，macOS 也不会主动弹窗询问。
2. 插件会在 Chrome 里打开 `chrome://inspect/#remote-debugging`。勾选 **Allow remote debugging for this browser instance**，然后告诉模型继续。
3. 模型开始操作时，Chrome 会弹窗询问是否允许连接，点 **Allow**。
4. 模型第一次打开某个网站时，DSH 会询问你。完全访问模式下 DSH 不询问。

连接后，模型每次打开页面都会收到所有标签页的标题和网址，这些内容会发给你配置的模型服务。使用前请读 [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)。

打开**设置 → Chrome Use**。这一页每次打开时会去 npm 查一次最新版本，有新版本时点**更新插件**，然后完全退出并重新打开 DSH。插件不会在后台自己更新。

更新用的是 DSH 自带的 pnpm，遵守它的发布冷却策略：默认会直接装上这个版本，并把它记进 profile 的 `minimumReleaseAgeExclude`；如果你配了更严格的策略，页面会提示什么时候可以更新。安装源（尤其是国内镜像）还没同步新版本时，页面会提示过几分钟再试。

本地路径（`link:`）安装不会出现更新按钮。要切回官方源，按这个顺序做：

1. 在**插件**页卸载。
2. 删掉卸载后留在 profile 里的符号链接，路径末尾不要带 `/`。Windows 上用 `rmdir`，不要加 `/s`。

```bash
   rm ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/node_modules/dsh-google-chrome-use
   ```

3. 按上面的步骤安装，然后完全退出并重新打开 DSH。
不删这个链接的话，重装时 pnpm 会把本地仓库的 `node_modules` 整个搬进插件目录，仓库的依赖就没了，插件也启用失败。`cordis.patch.yml` 里的配置行不受影响。

插件页目前没有配置表单。需要改配置时，在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里加一行（桌面版是 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml`），改完重启 DSH：

```yaml
- id: chrome-use
  name: dsh-google-chrome-use
  config:
    userDataDir: /Volumes/外置盘/chrome-profile

这种写法会替换整行配置，没写的项用默认值。

| 配置项 | 默认值 | 作用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `defaultTarget` | `dedicated` | 模型没指定时用哪个 Chrome，可选 `dedicated`、`my_chrome` |
| `allowMyChrome` | `true` | 是否允许连接你的 Chrome |
| `askBeforeNewSite` | `true` | 在你的 Chrome 里第一次打开某网站时是否询问。headless 模式没人能回答，会拒绝新网站，无人值守时要关掉 |
| `headless` | `false` | 独立 Chrome 不显示窗口 |
| `userDataDir` | DSH 数据目录下的 `chrome-use/chrome-profile` | 独立 Chrome 的配置目录，可能有几百 MB |
| `executablePath` | 自动查找 | Chrome 不在默认位置时指定 |
| `toolset` | `standard` | `standard` 26 个工具，`slim` 3 个，`full` 再加性能、内存和设备模拟 |
| `fileRoots` | `[]` | 除系统临时目录外，还允许上传和保存文件的目录 |
| `toolCallTimeoutSeconds` | `180` | 单次操作的超时秒数，第一次操作要等你点允许 |
| `extraArgs` | `[]` | 传给 chrome-devtools-mcp 的额外参数，比如 `--blockedUrlPattern=*://*.bank.example/*` |

没调用 `chrome_use` 时，只多一个工具定义。调用之后这个 DSH 进程里的会话都会带上浏览器工具，`standard` 约 6000 token，每次请求都算（通常有缓存）。大网页的快照可能有一两万 token。用不到时可以让模型调用 `chrome_use` 的 `action=stop` 断开。

如果模型不支持图片，截图会看不到，但它仍能靠页面快照工作。

**提示浏览器已经在运行：** 另一个 DSH 窗口正在用独立配置。关掉它，或者让那边断开。

**第一次操作超时：** Chrome 的 Allow 弹窗没点。点完让模型再试一次。

**多个会话同时用：** 同一个 DSH 进程里的会话共用一个浏览器连接。切换目标会影响所有会话。

**Chrome 和 Edge：** 上游只正式支持 Google Chrome。其他 Chromium 浏览器可以用 `executablePath` 试，但不保证能用。

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm run check
node scripts/e2e-dsh.mjs
```

- `pnpm run check`：单元测试，加上用真实无头 Chrome 跑的冒烟测试。
- `scripts/e2e-dsh.mjs`：在真实的 DSH 里跑完整流程，用脚本扮演模型，不需要账号。
- 给 `scripts/smoke.mjs` 或 `scripts/e2e-dsh.mjs` 加 `--headed`，就会用带窗口的 Chrome，也就是插件默认的模式。
浏览器能力全部来自 Google Chrome DevTools 团队的 chrome-devtools-mcp（Apache-2.0）。本项目与 Google 无关。
MIT

readme.section: Chrome Use: a real Chrome for DeepSeek Harness
readme.text:
[中文](README.md)

Lets DSH models use Google Chrome on your computer: open pages, read them, click, fill forms, pick dropdown options, upload files, handle dialogs and take screenshots. Works on macOS and Windows. So far Windows has only run the automated tests in CI, not the desktop app on a real machine, so please report anything you find.

readme.section: Chrome Use: a real Chrome for DeepSeek Harness
readme.text: The browser work is done by Chrome's official [chrome-devtools-mcp](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp). This plugin connects it to DSH: it loads on demand, chooses which Chrome to reach, handles each system's paths, sets privacy defaults and asks before opening a new site.

| | Dedicated Chrome (default) | My Chrome |
| --- | --- | --- |
| What it is | A separate Chrome profile that keeps its own logins | The Chrome you already use, with all your logins and tabs |
| Good for | Research, testing pages, accounts you choose to hand over | Tasks that need accounts you are already logged in to |
| Setup | None | Chrome 144 or later, one checkbox, a folder permission on macOS, and Allow when connecting |

Just say which one you want, and the model picks it:

```text
Open example.com in Chrome and tell me the page title
Use my own Chrome to check whether I have new GitHub notifications
```

No Chrome extension is needed, and there is nothing else to install.

You need [Google Chrome](https://www.google.com/chrome/) and the DeepSeek Harness desktop app (0.2.1 or a later 0.2.x).

1. Open **Plugins** in the desktop app, click **Add plugin**, and enter this under package name or address:

```text
   dsh-google-chrome-use@0.2.1
   ```

Choose the official source and click **Install**. For 24 hours after a release, DSH's pnpm holds back new versions, so keep the version number.

2. **Quit and reopen** the desktop app. Reloading the page does not load a new host plugin.

3. Try it in a conversation: "Open example.com in Chrome and tell me the page title."

<details>
<summary>Command line and custom profiles</summary>

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-google-chrome-use@0.2.1
```

Do not use this command on the `desktop` profile; use the Plugins page there. DSH 0.1.5's headless profile has no attachment store, so the model receives no screenshots there. Everything else works.

</details>

1. **macOS only:** in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Files & Folders, turn on Google Chrome under DeepSeek Harness (under your terminal app if you use the command line). Without this the plugin cannot read Chrome's folder, and macOS does not ask on its own.
2. The plugin opens `chrome://inspect/#remote-debugging` in Chrome. Tick **Allow remote debugging for this browser instance**, then tell the model to continue.
3. When the model starts, Chrome asks whether to allow the connection. Click **Allow**.
4. The first time the model opens a site, DSH asks you. DSH does not ask in full access mode.

Once connected, the model receives the titles and URLs of all your tabs each time it opens a page, and these go to the model service you configured. Read [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) (in Chinese) first.

Open **Settings → Chrome Use**. The page asks npm for the latest version each time it opens. When a newer one is listed, click **Update plugin**, then quit and reopen DSH. The plugin never updates itself in the background.

The update uses DSH's bundled pnpm under its release cooldown policy: by default pnpm installs the version and records it in the profile's `minimumReleaseAgeExclude`. With a stricter policy, the page says when you can update. If the install source, a mirror especially, does not have the new version yet, the page asks you to try again in a few minutes.

A local path (`link:`) install shows no update button. To move to the official source, do this in order:

1. Remove the plugin on the **Plugins** page.
2. Delete the symlink the removal leaves in the profile, with no trailing `/`. On Windows use `rmdir`, without `/s`.

```bash
   rm ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/node_modules/dsh-google-chrome-use
   ```

3. Install it as above, then quit and reopen DSH.

If the link stays, pnpm moves your checkout's whole `node_modules` into the plugin's directory on reinstall: the checkout loses its dependencies and the plugin fails to activate. The row in `cordis.patch.yml` stays.

The Plugins page has no settings form yet. Add a row to your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (`~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml` on desktop), then restart DSH:

```yaml
- id: chrome-use
  name: dsh-google-chrome-use
  config:
    userDataDir: /Volumes/External/chrome-profile

The row replaces the whole config, and anything left out takes its default.

| Key | Default | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `defaultTarget` | `dedicated` | Which Chrome to use when the model does not say: `dedicated` or `my_chrome` |
| `allowMyChrome` | `true` | Whether connecting to your Chrome is allowed |
| `askBeforeNewSite` | `true` | Whether to ask the first time a site opens in your Chrome. Nobody can answer in a headless run, so new sites are refused; turn this off for unattended use |
| `headless` | `false` | Run the dedicated Chrome without a window |
| `userDataDir` | `chrome-use/chrome-profile` in the DSH data directory | The dedicated profile, which can reach hundreds of MB |
| `executablePath` | Found automatically | Set this if Chrome is somewhere unusual |
| `toolset` | `standard` | `standard` has 26 tools, `slim` has 3, and `full` adds performance, memory and emulation |
| `fileRoots` | `[]` | Directories for uploads and saved files, besides the system temp directory |
| `toolCallTimeoutSeconds` | `180` | Timeout of one action; the first one waits for you to click Allow |
| `extraArgs` | `[]` | Extra chrome-devtools-mcp arguments, such as `--blockedUrlPattern=*://*.bank.example/*` |

Until `chrome_use` is called, the plugin adds one tool definition. After that, every session in this DSH process carries the browser tools: about 6,000 tokens per request with `standard`, usually cached. A snapshot of a large page can reach 10,000 to 20,000 tokens. Have the model call `chrome_use` with `action=stop` to disconnect when you no longer need it.

A model without image input cannot see screenshots, but it can still work from page snapshots.

**The browser is already running:** another DSH window is using the dedicated profile. Close it or disconnect it there.

**The first action times out:** Chrome's Allow dialog was not answered. Click it and ask the model to try again.

**Several sessions at once:** sessions in one DSH process share one browser connection, and switching targets affects all of them.
**Edge and other browsers:** upstream only officially supports Google Chrome. You can try other Chromium browsers with `executablePath`, with no guarantee.

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm run check
node scripts/e2e-dsh.mjs
```

- `pnpm run check`: unit tests, plus a smoke test with real headless Chrome.
- `scripts/e2e-dsh.mjs`: the full flow inside a real DSH with a scripted model. It needs no account.
- Add `--headed` to `scripts/smoke.mjs` or `scripts/e2e-dsh.mjs` to use Chrome with a window, the plugin's default.
All browser capabilities come from chrome-devtools-mcp by Google's Chrome DevTools team (Apache-2.0). This project is not affiliated with Google.
